name: Soyuz TM-28
about: Soyuz TM-28 (1998-047A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1998 Aug 13. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1998 Sep 13), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
